name: Gitgram AI Agent
description: AI agent for the Gitgram platform providing deterministic checkpointing, code intelligence, and A2A (agent-to-agent) coordination. Enables autonomous development workflows by managing restore points, analyzing repository structure, understanding code impact across the codebase, and coordinating with peer agents in multi-agent pipelines.

skills.name: Checkpoint Management
skills.description: Create and restore deterministic checkpoints of repository state. Supports tagging, branching, and point-in-time restore for safe autonomous agent workflows.

skills.name: Code Intelligence
skills.description: Deep code understanding including impact analysis, dependency tracing, context retrieval, and change detection across the repository graph.

skills.name: A2A Coordinator
skills.description: Agent-to-agent task delegation and coordination. Send tasks to peer agents, retrieve results, and discover available agents in the network.

skills.name: Repository Analysis
skills.description: Convert repository contents to structured text for LLM ingestion, resolve and query documentation, and produce full-repo snapshots for analysis.

mcpTools.name: before_action
mcpTools.description: Record intent before a destructive or significant action, enabling audit trails and rollback if needed.

mcpTools.name: after_action
mcpTools.description: Record the outcome of an action with success/failure status and a description of what was done.

mcpTools.name: tm_checkpoint_create
mcpTools.description: Create a named checkpoint of the current repository state for deterministic restore.

mcpTools.name: tm_checkpoint_restore
mcpTools.description: Restore the repository to a previously created checkpoint by name or ID.

mcpTools.name: tm_ready
mcpTools.description: Check whether the AITimeMachine service is ready and connected to the target repository.

mcpTools.name: tm_tag
mcpTools.description: Apply a human-readable tag to a checkpoint for easier discovery and restore.

mcpTools.name: gn_query
mcpTools.description: Query the GitNexus code graph for nodes, relationships, and structural information.

mcpTools.name: gn_impact
mcpTools.description: Analyze the impact of a proposed change across the dependency graph — surfaces affected files, functions, and modules.

mcpTools.name: gn_context
mcpTools.description: Retrieve enriched code context for a symbol, file, or module including callers, callees, and related nodes.

mcpTools.name: gn_detect_changes
mcpTools.description: Detect what has changed in the repository since a given checkpoint or commit reference.

mcpTools.name: gn_trace
mcpTools.description: Trace execution paths or data flow between two symbols or modules in the code graph.

mcpTools.name: a2a_send_task
mcpTools.description: Send a task to a peer agent via the A2A protocol and receive a task ID for polling.

mcpTools.name: a2a_get_task
mcpTools.description: Retrieve the current status and result of a previously sent A2A task.

mcpTools.name: a2a_list_agents
mcpTools.description: List all agents currently registered in the A2A agent network.

mcpTools.name: tm_repo_to_text
mcpTools.description: Serialize the repository (or a subtree) to a structured text format suitable for LLM context windows.

mcpTools.name: tm_docs_resolve
mcpTools.description: Resolve documentation references — locate the canonical doc source for a symbol, module, or topic.

mcpTools.name: tm_docs_query
mcpTools.description: Query indexed repository documentation with a natural language question and receive cited answers.
